# Reverend Jo

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

He is considered an ugly and plain man.

_Sources: [v3 c27 P22](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0022), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

He is decisive and makes up his mind quickly. He exhibits a radiant happiness in his life and marriage.

_Sources: [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Goals

- To serve a mission church in the slums on Patterson Street  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended St. Columbia, graduating in the spring. During his studies or courtship, he provided Philippa Gordon with a personal rule for decision-making. He accepted a post to lead a small mission church on Patterson Street in the slums. Jonas married Philippa Gordon in June, and the couple embarked on a trip through the land of Evangeline before settling down to live and work on Patterson Street.

_Sources: [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040)_

## Background by volume

- Given the advice to do what one would wish to have done when eighty years old  <sub>[v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)</sub>
